title: Everwind AW-51 Pack Steam Key Giveaway
description: Claim your free Everwind AW-51 Pack Steam Key! Please note that this DLC giveaway requires the base game and 10 ARP (Arena Reward Points) to claim a key. Fortunately, you can earn ARP for free every day simply by logging into the website.
instructions:
1. Log in to your free Alienware account and click the button to unlock your key (10 ARP required).
2. Launch the Steam client and click the Games menu option.
3. Choose "activate a Product on Steam" to redeem your Steam key.
